text.tspan: Spare parts · design specification
Same navy header, green active-section rule, Inter type, compact fields and shared controls as the repair card.
Part identity
Part number is the identifier. No serial-number field. Quantity and warehouse/location identify a stock entry. Free-text locations such as Crate #2; display Warehouse
/ Location.
Known part lookup
On leaving Part number, look up the known description, bulletins and repair history. Fill an untouched description; never silently overwrite user-entered text. The
underlying part-number knowledge base links records across authorized warehouses.
GSPN fetch
Only beside a single Part number inside Add part. Fetch fills Description only. Blue GSPN cue; hover/focus highlights Description, not Quantity/Location/Warehouse.
Source badge means capability, not provenance. Require Chrome bridge and signed-in GSPN; explain unavailable, timeout, retry and outdated-extension states.
Other warehouses
Unchecked by default. Show only authorized warehouses in the company. Other warehouse rows carry a textual badge as well as a blue tint; no implied automatic
transfer or courier booking.
Bulletins and history
Reuse documents from previous POs/repairs by part number. Automatically show available linked bulletins, with downloadable files and repair-history links. Preserve
authorization when opening or downloading them.
Stock take
Enter/scan part number and total quantity found. Repeat replaces, not increments. Multiple storage locations require individual counts. New part/location prompts
Add part with quantity and Fetch from GSPN. No serial-number workflow.
Missing entries
Not entered/scanned entries remain separate as Not yet counted. Explicit Out of stock confirmation records zero. Do not auto-zero unscanned stock. Confirmation
applies counts; cancelling draft applies nothing.
Save boundaries
Add to stock applies a normal addition. Save counted part changes the draft count, not inventory. Confirm stock take applies reconciliation, then read-only. Keep
cancel and destructive confirmation distinct.
Repair stock use
Existing repair allocation deducts stock; deleting the associated repair/part restores it under existing rules. Stock availability prompts remain in repair workflow; no
new ordering workflow is invented here.
Accessibility and density
1280 CSS px target, 38 px fields, comfortable compact row height, no horizontal overflow. Stock table document cells use links/icons, no new top-level Fetch button.
Modal body scrolls when necessary; header/actions remain available.
Scope
Editable design only. Example inventory/counts are illustrative. Production, local database and application code are unchanged.
